name: Patro Clock
author: samir pokhrel
description: Omarchy's clock with a Bikram Sambat calendar beside the Gregorian one. Swipe sideways in the popup to cross between them.

barWidget.description: A drop-in replacement for the built-in clock. The calendar popup draws the same month in either Bikram Sambat or Gregorian, laid out to identical size, and a two-finger horizontal swipe crosses between them.

schema.label: Calendar
schema.description: Which calendar the popup opens on. Swiping sideways in the popup changes it and writes the choice back here.

schema.label: Bar format
schema.description: Qt date format for the bar label. 'ww' is substituted with the ISO week number. Right-clicking the label walks the common formats.

schema.label: Alternate bar format
schema.description: The second format in the right-click ring.

schema.label: Vertical bar format
schema.description: Used when the bar is vertical. Newlines stack the label.

schema.label: Week starts on
schema.description: Gregorian view only — the Nepali view always starts on Sunday. Leave unset to follow the system locale. Clicking the grid's 'W' heading also toggles it.

schema.label: Swipe sensitivity
schema.description: How much sideways scroll counts as one swipe, in wheel-angle units. Around 120 is one notch. Raise it if the calendar flips too eagerly, lower it if a full swipe does nothing.

schema.label: Birth year
schema.description: Set this and a second progress bar tracks a life against the expectancy below. 0 hides it. Double-tapping the year bar in the popup does the same thing.

schema.label: Life expectancy
schema.description: Years, used only when a birth year is set.
